title: Import asset archive
description: Import an archive into the current asset folder.
moreFolders: Additional folders will also be imported.
uploadHint: Keep this page open until the upload finishes.
backgroundHint: The archive is uploaded. Import continues in the background.
retryHint: Successfully imported files will not be imported again.
connectionLost: Could not refresh progress. Tap to reconnect.

errors.ARCHIVE_UNAVAILABLE: Archive import is not available yet. Try again shortly.
errors.ARCHIVE_UNSUPPORTED: Choose a ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ or TGZ archive.
errors.ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE: Archives must be at most 128 MB, and unpacked files at most 512 MB in total.
errors.ARCHIVE_FILE_TOO_LARGE: A file in this archive exceeds the 64 MB limit.
errors.ARCHIVE_TOO_MANY_FILES: An archive can contain up to 2,000 files.
errors.ARCHIVE_UNSAFE_PATH: The archive contains an invalid or excessively deep folder path.
errors.ARCHIVE_DUPLICATE_PATH: The archive contains the same file path more than once. Repack it and try again.
errors.ARCHIVE_LINK_NOT_ALLOWED: The archive contains links or special files. Repack it with regular files only.
errors.ARCHIVE_EMPTY: No supported files were found in this archive.
errors.ARCHIVE_INVALID: This archive is damaged or invalid. Repack it and try again.
errors.ARCHIVE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: There is not enough storage for the unpacked files. Free up space and retry.
errors.ARCHIVE_RATE_LIMIT: Too many archive imports. Finish your current imports or try again later.
errors.ARCHIVE_FOLDER_MISSING: The destination folder no longer exists. Start a new import in another folder.
errors.ARCHIVE_STORAGE_ERROR: The file could not be stored. Please retry.
errors.ARCHIVE_NETWORK_ERROR: The connection was interrupted. Please retry.
errors.ARCHIVE_INTERRUPTED: The import was interrupted. Retry to continue from saved progress.
errors.ARCHIVE_UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE: The archive upload is incomplete. Please retry.
errors.ARCHIVE_NOT_READY: The archive is still being checked. Please wait.
errors.ARCHIVE_EXPIRED: This import has expired. Select the archive to start again.
errors.ARCHIVE_NOT_FOUND: This import could not be found.
errors.ARCHIVE_UNAUTHORIZED: Sign in again to continue importing.
errors.ARCHIVE_CONFLICT: This upload has changed. Select the archive to start again.
errors.ARCHIVE_BUSY: The import is still running. You can minimize it.
errors.ARCHIVE_NOT_RETRYABLE: Select the archive to start a new import.
errors.ARCHIVE_FILE_MISMATCH: Choose the same archive with the same name and size.
errors.ARCHIVE_RESELECT: Select the archive again to finish uploading.
errors.ARCHIVE_INVALID_REQUEST: The import request was invalid. Please try again.
